feedback: can you make this game 2.5D with minor animation

selection.reason: Making the game visually 2.5D with minor animations can be entirely contained within the renderGame function by applying fake depth (extrusion/shadows), isometric-like offsets, and using frameCount for animation, without altering the core 2D logic.

patch.notes: Replaced renderGame to introduce 2.5D graphics using pseudo-3D boxes (front, top, and right face logic) and incorporated minor animations like bobbing, animated waves, and bubble streams.
